description: Work out a salaried employee's pay for a pay period they only partly worked because they started or left during it. Send the full salary for the period, the period's first and last day, and the start date, the last day employed, or both. Get back the prorated salary by workdays (scheduled workdays employed / scheduled workdays in the period) and by calendar days (days employed / days in the period), the one you choose as the answer, the day counts and the daily rate. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/partial-period-salary). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

employed_from.description: First day employed, if it falls inside the period (a new hire), YYYY-MM-DD.

employed_through.description: Last day employed, if it falls inside the period (an exit), YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'new hire, semimonthly' (your own text, echoed; not a person's name).

method.description: Which proration is the answer (both are shown): workdays (default) or calendar_days.

period_end.description: Last day of the pay period, YYYY-MM-DD (the period is 1 to 31 days).

period_salary.description: Salary for one full pay period (what the employee is paid when they work the whole period).

period_start.description: First day of the pay period, YYYY-MM-DD.

work_days.description: Optional: the employee's scheduled days of the week (default mon to fri).
